draft.subject: Your notification badge ticket — and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge that won't clear — that ticket is still open and we're looking at it now; I'll come back to you as soon as I have something concrete. And as mentioned, a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

In the meantime, I'd like to help River Ventures get the first bit of real work into Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the natural starting point.

Would a 15-minute call this week suit, so I can walk through setting up your first project with you?

Best,
Priya
